knobs.note: Untouched ready tickets pre-planned per project per tick.
Overrides PREPLAN_AHEAD for the READY class only. Unset means follow PREPLAN_AHEAD.
Stale re-plans one ticket may buy per 24h.

P2: skip the pre-plan when it adds nothing: triage sized it S (size=S on the queue line), it is copy/docs (kind=copy|docs, or the board title prefix via bin/kind-gate.sh), or its build is already running. The build stage plans it. 0 pre-plans them as before.
Will skip the pre-plan for a key the deterministic readiness filter calls not ready. 0 turns the filter off. (BH-2543; stub until the readiness/cadence child lands, so it changes nothing yet.)
Will cut a project's pre-plan cadence when its adopt rate stays under this percent. 0 never cuts. (BH-2543; stub until the readiness/cadence child lands, so it changes nothing yet.)
Will be the bought pre-plans (adopted + stale) a project needs in the window before its adopt rate counts. (BH-2543; stub until the readiness/cadence child lands, so it changes nothing yet.)
Will be the window the adopt rate is measured over. (BH-2543; stub until the readiness/cadence child lands, so it changes nothing yet.)
Will be the least time between two pre-plan launches for a project whose cadence is cut. (BH-2543; stub until the readiness/cadence child lands, so it changes nothing yet.)
Will be how long one adoption answer is reused before the route is asked again. (BH-2543; stub until the readiness/cadence child lands, so it changes nothing yet.)

0 makes this lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row, so the stop is visible in the ledger rather than being a lane that went quiet.

Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs this lane may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. today's ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call, so a cliff or a failure on the standing lane cannot descend into one that costs ~100x (#1141, the $793 descent).

Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend — never from the box's own logs/cost.csv. A second, project-scoped ceiling is the lane.<id>.<project>.llm_usd_cap_day row, which is read only when somebody wrote it.
